name: Hexa Tradex Limited
summary: Hexa Tradex Limited operates as a dealer, trader, import and export agent, representative, contractor, buyer, seller, and broker in India. The company operates through two segments: Trading and Other Activities; and Investment and Finance. It engages in buying, selling, and trading a variety of products. Hexa Tradex Limited was incorporated in 2010 and is based in New Delhi, India.
